instructions: Start in a straight line, hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows around 45°.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Hips sagging or piking — squeeze your glutes to stay straight.
Flaring elbows out to a T — keep them closer to the body.
Rushing the bottom — touch the floor with control.

instructions: Lie flat with eyes just behind the bar, feet planted.
Grip slightly wider than shoulders; unrack and lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press the bar up and slightly back until your arms lock out over your shoulders.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest instead of controlling the descent.
Flaring the elbows straight out — keep them roughly 45° from your torso.
Lifting the hips off the bench to force the press.
cues: Bar to chest, press to lockout

instructions: Sit on the bench with dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back and kick them up.
Start with arms locked over your shoulders, palms facing your feet.
Lower the dumbbells to chest height, then press up and slightly together.
mistakes: Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides.
Clanging the dumbbells together at the top instead of controlling them.
Bouncing at the bottom of each rep.

instructions: Hands on a bench or sturdy surface, body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge of the surface.
Press back up until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Hips sagging or spiking out of the straight line.
Flaring the elbows straight out.
Half reps that never touch the chest to the edge.

instructions: Set the bench to about 30°; sit back with dumbbells at chest height.
Press up and slightly together over your upper chest.
Lower with control until you feel a stretch, then press again.
mistakes: Setting the incline too steep — it becomes a shoulder press.
Bouncing the dumbbells off the chest.
Elbows flaring straight out to the sides.

instructions: Lie back with a soft bend in your elbows, weights above your chest.
Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Hug the arms back together over your chest — squeeze, don’t clang.
mistakes: Bending the elbows deeply and turning it into a press.
Dropping too heavy a weight toward the floor.
Bouncing at the bottom of the stretch.

instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip, hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Start by pulling your shoulder blades down and back.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower with control to a full hang.
mistakes: Kicking or swinging for momentum instead of pulling smoothly.
Stopping short of a full hang at the bottom — half reps build half strength.
Craning the neck to "reach" the bar with the chin.

instructions: Anchor the band at mid-height (door, rack, post) and hold one end in each hand.
Step back until there is tension, then hinge slightly with a flat back.
Pull your elbows past your torso, squeeze the shoulder blades, and return slowly.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears.
Leaning back to move the band instead of rowing with the arms.
Letting the band snap back with no control.

instructions: One knee and the same-side hand on a bench, other foot planted.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down under your shoulder.
Row it to your hip, squeezing the shoulder blade, then lower under control.
mistakes: Rotating the torso to heave the weight up.
Yanking with the arm instead of driving with the elbow and back.
Shortening the range — no full stretch at the bottom.

instructions: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders, thighs locked under the pads.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Control the bar back up until your arms are fully long, then repeat.
mistakes: Rocking the torso to yank the bar down.
Pulling behind the neck — always to the front.
Half reps that never return to a full stretch.

instructions: Stand tall facing the cable, arms straight, bar at upper-chest height.
Pull the bar down to your thighs using the lats — elbows stay long.
Squeeze at the bottom for a beat, then return with control.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a pushdown or tricep motion.
Leaning too far forward and rocking through the rep.
Swinging the bar instead of moving smoothly.
cues: Lats pull the bar to thighs

instructions: Sit tall with a slight knee bend, chest up, grip the handle.
Pull the handle to your belly button, elbows brushing your ribs.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together, then let the handle return with control.
mistakes: Rocking the whole torso back and forth for momentum.
Shrugging the shoulders instead of pulling with the back.
Letting the weight stack slam between reps.

instructions: Sit square to the cable, one handle in hand, other hand braced.
Pull the handle to your hip, elbow brushing your ribs.
Squeeze the shoulder blade, then return until your arm is fully long.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to heave the weight.
Shrugging the shoulder instead of pulling with the back.
Shortening the stretch at the return.

instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, dumbbells hanging straight down.
Row both dumbbells to your lower ribs, elbows brushing your sides.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together, then lower with control.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad to heave the row.
Shrugging instead of driving the elbows back.
Bouncing at the bottom of each rep.

instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit back and down as if reaching for a chair behind you.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up tall.
mistakes: Knees caving inward — think knees over little toes.
Heels lifting off the floor.
Rounding your lower back at the bottom.
cues: Depth to hip below knee if comfortable

instructions: Hold one dumbbell (or a kettlebell) at chest height with both hands.
Squat down between your knees, keeping the weight close.
Drive up, keeping your chest tall and the weight against you.
mistakes: Letting the weight drift away from your chest.
Stopping short of a comfortable depth.
Rising onto the toes at the bottom.

instructions: Bar on your upper traps, feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Brace your core, then sit back and down between your hips.
Descend until your hip crease passes your knee (if mobility allows), then drive up through your whole foot.
mistakes: Knees caving inward on the way up.
Heels lifting — the weight drifts to the toes.
Losing the brace and rounding the lower back at the bottom.

instructions: Bar racked on your front delts, elbows high, feet shoulder-width.
Brace and sit straight down, keeping your torso as upright as possible.
Drive through your whole foot and stand tall without letting the elbows drop.
mistakes: Elbows dropping and the bar rolling forward.
Leaning the torso into a back-squat shape.
Heels lifting off the floor.

instructions: Hold the weight in front of your thighs, feet hip-width.
Push your hips back, letting the weight slide down your legs.
Feel the hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
mistakes: Bending the knees into a squat instead of hinging.
Letting the bar drift forward from the legs.
Rounding the lower back at the bottom.

instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes out, bar close to your shins.
Grip inside your knees, chest tall, hips lower than a conventional pull.
Drive the floor away and stand tall; lock out with glutes, not a lean-back.
mistakes: Hips shooting up first, turning it into a stiff-leg pull.
Bar drifting forward from the legs.
Over-leaning back at the top instead of standing tall.

instructions: Bar on your upper traps, feet hip-width, knees softly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso until the hamstrings stop you.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall, keeping the back flat.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back as the torso lowers.
Loading too heavy before the hinge pattern is solid.
Bending the knees into a squat instead of hinging.

instructions: Kneel with your ankles anchored and your body upright from knees to head.
Lower forward as slowly as your hamstrings allow, hips staying straight.
Catch yourself with your hands, then push or curl back up.
mistakes: Breaking at the hips instead of keeping knees-to-head in one line.
Dropping quickly instead of resisting the descent.
Holding the breath through the rep.
cues: Push back up from the floor

instructions: Upper back on a bench, feet planted hip-width, shins vertical at the top.
Drive through your heels until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze the glutes hard at the top for a beat, then lower with control.
mistakes: Hyperextending the lower back instead of stopping at level.
Pushing through the toes rather than the heels.
Chinning or flaring the ribs at the top.

instructions: Sit with your back and hips flush against the pad, feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower the sled until your knees approach your chest without your hips rolling up.
Press through your whole foot until your legs are nearly straight — never locked.
mistakes: Letting the hips curl off the seat at the bottom.
Slamming the knees into lockout.
Knees caving inward during the press.

instructions: Sit tall with pads on the outside of your knees.
Drive your knees outward against the pads without leaning back.
Pause at full opening, then return with control — don’t let the weight slam.
mistakes: Using momentum by rocking the whole body.
Shrugging or leaning the shoulders during the drive.
Cutting the range short and skipping the controlled return.

instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is level.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower one vertebra at a time.
mistakes: Lifting with the lower back instead of the glutes.
Feet too far away — the hamstrings take over.
Stopping short of level or over-arching past it.

instructions: Stand tall, then take a comfortable step forward.
Lower until both knees are about 90°, front knee over your ankle.
Drive through the front heel to return; alternate legs.
mistakes: Front knee collapsing inward.
Taking too-short a step so the knee travels well past the toes.
Leaning the torso forward instead of staying upright.

instructions: Take a long split stance — front foot flat, back heel up.
Lower your back knee straight down toward the floor.
Stop just above the floor, then drive up through the front foot.
mistakes: Front heel lifting as you descend.
Stance too short, forcing the knee far past the toes.
Torso tipping forward under load.

instructions: Place your whole foot on a knee-height step or bench.
Drive through that heel to stand tall on the step — no pushing off the back foot.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.
mistakes: Pushing off the floor with the back leg.
Bouncing off the bottom instead of controlling it.
Knee caving inward as you drive up.

instructions: Stand tall, balls of your feet on a step or the floor.
Rise as high as your calves allow and pause at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel a full stretch at the bottom.
mistakes: Bouncing reps with no pause at the top.
Cutting the range — no full stretch at the bottom.
Bending the knees to sneak in quadriceps help.

instructions: Stand tall, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your abs and glutes so your ribs stay down.
Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms lock out beside your ears.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to cheat the press.
Flaring the ribs up instead of keeping the torso rigid.
Pressing forward of the shoulders instead of straight up.

instructions: Bar at collarbone height, grip just outside your shoulders, elbows slightly ahead of the bar.
Brace your glutes and abs, then press the bar straight up.
Shift your head "through the window" as the bar passes your face; lock out over your ears.
mistakes: Leaning back to turn it into an incline press.
Pressing around the head instead of moving the head back and then through.
Legs soft — the whole body should be a rigid column.

instructions: Sit or stand tall, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Lock out overhead, then reverse the rotation on the way down.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to help the press.
Rushing the rotation — smooth, not jerky.
Elbows flaring forward of the shoulders.

instructions: From a push-up position, walk your feet in and lift your hips high.
Lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Hips dropping and losing the pike shape.
Flaring the elbows straight out.
Lowering the nose instead of the crown toward the floor.

instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, a slight lean forward, soft knees.
Raise your arms out to the sides, leading with the elbows.
Stop at shoulder height, then lower slowly — the way down is half the rep.
mistakes: Swinging the weights up with body english.
Shrugging the traps instead of lifting the arms.
Going far above shoulder height and turning it into a trap exercise.

instructions: Stand on the middle of a band, one end in each hand.
With a slight forward lean, raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the tension — the band resists both directions.
mistakes: Jerking the arms up instead of moving smoothly.
Shrugging the shoulders as the arms rise.
Leaning back to make the top easier.

instructions: Hinge forward at the hips, dumbbells hanging under your shoulders.
Raise your arms out to the sides with a soft bend in the elbows.
Squeeze the back of your shoulders at the top, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Using heavy weights and swinging the torso.
Turning it into a row by bending the elbows deeply.
Standing upright — the hinge is what targets the rear delts.
cues: Squeeze the back of the shoulders

instructions: Set the rope at upper-face height and hold the ends.
Pull the rope toward your forehead, splitting your hands apart.
Finish with knuckles beside your ears, then return with control.
mistakes: Pulling to the chest instead of the face.
Using too much weight so the elbows drop.
Shrugging at the finish instead of keeping the shoulders down.

instructions: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weight up without moving the elbows forward.
Lower all the way down until the arm is straight.
mistakes: Swinging the torso to start each rep.
Elbows drifting forward and turning it into a front raise.
Cutting the bottom half of the range.

instructions: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip, palms facing your body.
Curl straight up, keeping the wrists locked like hammers.
Lower slowly to full extension.
mistakes: Rotating the wrist during the rep.
Bouncing at the bottom with the elbows.
Leaning back to finish the top.

instructions: Stand on the band with both feet, ends in your hands, palms up.
Curl against the tension, elbows staying at your sides.
Resist the band on the way down — the negative is the exercise.
mistakes: Stepping too narrow so there is slack at the bottom.
Leaning back to help the top.
Fast, uncontrolled returns.

instructions: Face the cable, elbows pinned to your ribs, grip the bar or rope.
Push down until the arms fully lock out.
Let the handle return slowly to the start without the elbows drifting forward.
mistakes: Elbows traveling forward and turning it into a chest press.
Leaning body weight onto the cable to push the stack down.
Cutting the lockout short.

instructions: Hold one dumbbell in both hands overhead, elbows narrow and pointing forward.
Lower the weight behind your head until you feel a deep tricep stretch.
Extend back up to lockout without flaring the elbows.
mistakes: Elbows flaring wide and losing the tricep line.
Lowering to the neck instead of behind the head.
Arching the back to heave the weight up.

instructions: Set up on your forearms and toes, elbows under shoulders.
Level your hips so your body forms one straight line.
Breathe steadily and hold — stop when the hips drop.
mistakes: Hips sagging toward the floor or spiking upward.
Holding your breath.
Chin craned up — keep the neck long.

instructions: Lie on your side, forearm under your shoulder, feet stacked (or staggered for balance).
Lift your hips until your body forms one straight line.
Hold, breathing steadily, then switch sides.
mistakes: Hips sagging toward the floor.
Rolling forward or backward out of the side line.
Holding the breath.

instructions: Lie on your back, arms straight up, knees bent 90° over your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor, then return and switch sides.
mistakes: Lower back arching off the floor as the limbs extend.
Rushing the reps — slow is the point.
Holding the breath instead of breathing steadily.

instructions: Start on hands and knees with a long, neutral spine.
Extend the opposite arm and leg until level with your torso.
Pause, return with control, and switch sides.
mistakes: Hips tilting as the leg lifts.
Raising the limbs above the torso line and arching the back.
Rushing — hold the pause at the top.

instructions: Stand side-on to the anchor, handle held at your chest.
Press the handle straight out in front of you without twisting.
Resist the pull for a beat, return, and repeat.
mistakes: Letting the cable rotate the torso.
Standing too close, so there is no tension to resist.
Holding the breath against the twist.

instructions: Hang from the bar with a dead, still body.
Raise your knees toward your chest using the abs, not a swing.
Lower slowly until the body is still, then repeat.
mistakes: Swinging into a kip to generate momentum.
Rushing the descent so the next rep starts from a swing.
Bending at the hips only — curl the pelvis too.

instructions: Hang from the bar with your body still and legs straight.
Raise your legs toward the bar or to at least hip height, curling the pelvis.
Lower slowly until the body is fully still, then repeat.
mistakes: Kipping or swinging into the raise.
Only hinging at the hips without curling the pelvis.
Rushing the descent so the next rep starts from a swing.

instructions: Run at a pace where you could hold a conversation.
Keep your stride quick and light, posture tall.
Finish feeling like you could keep going — easy means easy.
mistakes: Running every easy run too hard.
Slouching or over-striding as fatigue builds.
Ignoring pain that changes your gait.

instructions: Walk faster than a stroll — effort 5–6 out of 10.
Stay tall and swing your arms naturally.
Keep a steady pace for the whole prescribed time.
mistakes: Slowing into a window-shopping pace.
Leaning far forward from the waist.
Stopping and starting so often the effort never settles.

instructions: Elbows near your ribs, wrists doing the turning.
Jump barely off the floor — one low hop per rope pass.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and breathe steadily.
mistakes: Jumping far too high and tiring early.
Swinging the whole arms instead of the wrists.
Staring down and rounding the posture.

instructions: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders, feet shoulder-width.
Squat until your hips pass your knees, keeping your chest tall.
Drive up and press the dumbbells overhead in one fluid motion.
mistakes: Pressing before the legs finish driving.
Arching the back to muscle the press.
Letting the elbows flare or drop during the squat.

instructions: Start on hands and toes with knees hovering just off the floor.
Move one hand and the opposite foot forward a small step.
Keep your hips level and quiet — small steps, not long lunges.
mistakes: Hips swaying side to side.
Knees lifting too high and turning it into a crawl.
Rushing so the lower back sags.

instructions: Hold a heavy dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Walk with short, steady steps, shoulders down and back.
Keep your ribs stacked over your hips — no leaning or side-bending.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.
Leaning away from the weight or letting one hip drop.
Dropping the chest and rounding forward.

cues: Bar on traps or at side
